background.note: The living Gate background, life-proof v1 (cloud-shadow drift, leaf drift, pollen, wind bed) - the current living version of the Gate piece for this scene, per the parts-catalog current-version marks. NOT the v1 still plate.

characters.cutout: canon cutout: wispkin (cracked white skull mask, small black hooded body, smoky trail)

segments.action: Wispkin drifts slowly across the frame from left to right, bobbing gently on its smoky trail, tilting its cracked white skull mask side to side as if listening to something far away
Wispkin rears back, gathers swirling dark purple-black energy around its small hands, then throws both hands forward and releases Dark Wave - a rippling wave of dark energy rolling out in front of it

characters.cutout: canon cutout: dorowani (blue bipedal creature, red fin cheeks, red eyes, light belly, dorsal fin, tan shell on its back)

segments.action: Dorowani hops forward twice with springy knees, landing planted and alert, red fin cheeks flaring, looking toward Wispkin
Dorowani raises both hands and charges a Water Orb - a sphere of swirling blue water growing and spinning between its palms, droplets orbiting it
Dorowani pushes both hands forward and launches the Water Orb ahead of it in a rushing arc of water, bracing with one foot back as the orb leaves its hands

purpose: The planned first freedom test: two characters, free-text segments, one living background. Wispkin drifts in tilting its mask, then performs Dark Wave; Dorowani hops forward, charges a Water Orb, and pushes it out.
